name: history-index-retained-memory
goal: Keep history index aggregation bounded while preserving all revision evidence.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The history index retains complete record views and focused output after writing each revision, although index aggregation needs only summaries and measurements.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing HistoryIndexService.build case checks archived source and media but never checks whether unused payloads remain retained or whether compact summaries preserve index results.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Existing build case fails on retained written payloads; red f221424055c7 records the exact command at c3c32fbf69.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Project only aggregation fields after writing complete revision details; preserve workload measurements and historical gaps.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged build case passes at 8ee38965ae; matching green 9c285c2e4bca uses the same profile and command.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
